title: Cruise Upgrade Call
scenario: A caller offers a cabin upgrade if you pay by gift card before departure.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.
answers.D: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.

explanation: Cruise Upgrade Call: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Cruise lines do not use gift cards for upgrades.
